screenerUrl.title: Finviz screener URL (optional)
screenerUrl.description: Paste any screen from finviz.com, e.g. https://finviz.com/screener.ashx?v=111&f=cap_large,fa_pe_u15&o=-marketcap. Filters, signal, tickers and sort are taken from it; the actor always returns every column.

screenerType.title: Universe
screenerType.description: Stocks or ETFs. Ignored when the URL already points to the ETF screener.

filters.title: Filter codes (optional)
filters.description: Finviz filter codes, as they appear after f= in a screener URL, e.g. cap_large, sec_technology, fa_pe_u20, sh_short_o20, ta_rsi_os30, geo_usa, idx_sp500. Added to any URL filters.

signal.title: Signal (optional)
signal.description: Finviz signal code, e.g. ta_topgainers, ta_toplosers, ta_newhigh, ta_newlow, ta_mostactive, ta_unusualvolume, ta_overbought, ta_oversold, n_majornews, n_insiderbuying, n_upgrades, n_earningsbefore.

tickers.title: Tickers (optional)
tickers.description: Look up specific tickers instead of screening, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, NVDA.

sortBy.title: Sort (optional)
sortBy.description: Finviz sort code (the o= parameter), e.g. -marketcap, -change, -volume, pe, -relativevolume. A leading minus sorts descending.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Cap on tickers returned. Controls cost. Finviz pages hold 20 rows.
